Rhodes Arena]] |champion = |tourney = |tourney_result = }} {{2020–21 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Akron Zips men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Akron]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Zips, led by fourth-year head coach [[John Groce]], played their home games at the [[James A. Rhodes Arena]] in [[Akron, Ohio]] as members of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the Zips finished the season 15–8, 12–6 in [[2020–21 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC play]] to finish in a tie for third place. They defeated [[2020–21 Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball team|Bowling Green]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 Buffalo Bulls men's basketball team|Buffalo]] in the semifinals. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Akron Zips men's basketball team|Zips]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 24–7, 14–4 in MAC play to win the East Division. They were to play [[2019–20 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team|Ohio]] in the conference tournament before the season ended due to the COVID-19 pandemic. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
